notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 1998, from volume 45 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (45minutesofsanfran1998san, labelled 1998). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 1997: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote and the motion or resolution number. From 5 November 1998 the minutes change layout ('Meeting Minutes', 'SPEAKER(S)', 'NAYES'), and on several pages the action word, the speaker list and the vote names are printed as separate columns, so the OCR runs them together; those votes were read name by name and given by hand. Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting it sits under; the volume's own running headers were used, because the OCR mangles most first-page dates ('FEBRUARYS', 'APRII 1fi 1QQR'). Two kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; and what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property, taken from items withdrawn, heard only as a draft environmental report, or still continued when the volume ends. A continuance (including an item under 'Items to be continued' whose action reads 'Approved as proposed', which approves the continuance), a motion of intent, a failed motion, a bare 'Take D.R.' with no outcome, or an informational report is not a decision. Vote tallies were counted from the commissioners named in the AYES and NOES lists; three items print a commissioner in both, and those carry no tally. Every raw.text span was cut mechanically from the item text it cites. The minutes name applicants, owners, architects, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field. Companies, institutions, businesses and named buildings are kept.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 45 (45minutesofsanfran1998san, 1998) was read: 44 regular meetings, 8 January to 17 December 1998, with their addenda and corrections, and the joint hearings with the Redevelopment Agency Commission (15 January, 12 May, 8 and 17 December), the Recreation and Park Commission (21 May) and the Building Inspection Commission (28 May). Cancelled: 29 January, 29 October, 26 November, 24 and 31 December (cancellation notices bound in); 2 and 30 July were cancelled by the Commission on 15 January. No meeting is minuted for 30 April. Next: volume 46 (1999), then volumes 47-58 (2000-2005).
coverage.note: 412 OCR pages with text out of 592 viewer pages (594 scanned leaves; the empty ones are blank versos, the library cards and the digitization notice), read in one session by a single reader with no sub-agents. 'mentions' counts the 656 numbered calendar items the pages hold, continuances and policy items included; 225 findings came out of them.
